## Accessibility checklist (WCAG 2.2 AA)
- [ ] Semantic HTML: landmarks, headings in order, buttons are `<button>`
- [ ] Images have meaningful alt text, or `alt=""` if decorative
- [ ] Every form input has a visible label
- [ ] Works with keyboard only: Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, Escape
- [ ] Focus is clearly visible on every interactive element
- [ ] Text contrast is at least 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text and UI parts)
- [ ] No errors from the axe linter
